pages/shared.js.after:
status: p.status,
    membershipKind: p.membershipKind === "guest" ? "guest" : "member",
    nickname: typeof p.nickname === "string" ? p.nickname : "",
    membershipConfirmed:

pages/players/index.wxml.after: <text class="player-name">{{item.name}}</text><view wx:if="{{item.membershipKind==='guest'}}" class="temporary-player-marker" aria-role="img" aria-label="临时球员"/>

pages/manage-players/index.wxml.after: <view class="bold"><text>{{item.name}}</text><view wx:if="{{item.membershipKind==='guest'}}" class="temporary-player-marker" aria-role="img" aria-label="临时球员"/><text class="player-number-note">

pages/player-detail/index.wxml.after: <view class="profile-details"><view class="profile-detail"><text class="detail-label">球员身份</text><text class="detail-value">{{player.membershipKind==='guest'?'临时球员':'正式球员'}}</text></view>

pages/manage-player/index.wxml.after: <view wx:if="{{id}}" class="card player-identity-card"><view class="between identity-heading"><text class="field-label">球员身份</text><text class="identity-value">{{membershipKind==='guest'?'临时球员':'正式球员'}}</text></view><block wx:if="{{membershipKind==='guest'}}"><view class="hint">转正后保留原球员身份、照片和比赛历史。</view><view wx:if="{{status!=='active'}}" class="hint">请先恢复为在队状态并保存，再转正。</view><button class="ui-button ui-block promote-player" size="mini" bindtap="promote" disabled="{{loading||busy||promoteConfirming||conflict||uncertain||status!=='active'}}">转为正式球员</button></block></view><view class="card"><view class="row portrait-editor">
